answer: When hiring reviewers for summit maps, sable surveys or fable editing, draw tickets from locked stake units rather than account names. Publish a random seed after stake is frozen, then sample units without replacement. Splitting 100 units among a thousand keys still gives only 100 tickets, so aliases gain no extra selection probability. An attacker must acquire and immobilize more stake to control a panel, paying capital and opportunity costs. This resists identity multiplication, but not domination by wealthy owners.
